resolution.note:
Both refuters killed every blocking finding, so the row stamps PASS:verify-refuted and this REVISE stays as the record. pedagogy §45 line 34: scope: Refuted on the scope lens: (a) the rule's own wording and (d) the judge binding AE101-shaped text to a builder-leader training. Two of the judge's claims check out, one does not, and the blocking flag is inconsistent with how the same finding was filed elsewhere.

Confirmed:
- `grep -ci leap` on `curriculum/exercises/three-minds-one-synthesis.md` returns 0.
- 39 of 59 exercise files mention "leap" (59 files counted with `ls`). 39 files also contain "Leap test" or "leap-test" specifically.
- Line 34 is the `<!-- maintainer -->` start, so the line is inside the region the rule governs.

Not confirmed:
- **Sibling claim is false.** The judge says three-retrievers-one-curator "was also filed REVISE on this rule". Its stored verdict is `curriculum/evals/instances/agents-101--exercise--three-retrievers-one-curator.pedagogy.json`, which has §45 as N/A, non-blocking, overall PASS.
- That N/A reason reads: "engineer own-codebase Monday leap test (AE101/APT101 corpus: 39 of 59 exercises); A101 exercises name-your-crux and three-minds-one-synthesis carry none. Rule question for the maintainer: does §45 reach A101".
- **Rule text.** §45 in `/home/user/agents-102-core/memory/check_pedagogy.md` (line 115) says "3 observable outcomes student exhibits on own codebase by next working day". Its examples are all engineer moves: worktree, test-first, `CLAUDE.local.md`. The compounded note `2026-05-03-pedagogy-legacy-megaeval-axes-promoted-to-maintainer-block-format.md` says §45 came from legacy AE101 megaeval files. No clause carves out A101, but the "own codebase" frame is engineer-side, and this exercise is for builder-leaders working on a challenge and a memory folder.
- **A101 convention.**
  - Of the 14 A101-listed exercise files I could check, only 4 carry a leap test.
  - The ones that do (share-your-work, design-the-sharing-plan, test-the-sharing-plan, personal-site-with-guardrails) are the shared AE101-style exercises.
  - name-your-crux, eval-loop, hallucination-bakeoff, joint-double-diamond, name-your-challenge and the other native A101 exercises carry none.
- **Inconsistent treatment.**
  - build-for-the-gap, personal-agent-homework, three-retrievers-one-curator and module-3-prework were judged N/A.
  - The A101 REVISE rows for name-your-crux, joint-double-diamond, eval-loop, build-your-challenge-memory and hallucination-bakeoff are all `blocking:false`, and the first three of those exercises have an overall PASS.
  - Only this file and audit-your-agent carry `blocking:true` on the same finding.
  - eval-loop's own judge notes this "may be a rule-scope question (AE101-shaped wording, 'own codebase')".
- **Harm claim.** "A trainer cannot tell whether the student left able to do something on Monday" is generic. This exercise already has a trainer-readable falsifiable check: the Close, "freeze the briefing with the doubted line beside it", which Module 5 consumes. The maintainer block also has time-budget watch-fors for the missed doubt-naming beat.

At most this is a non-blocking rule-scope question for the maintainer (does §45 reach A101?), not a blocking defect. Applying the fix as blocking would also rewrite a body whose peers are exempt or non-blocking.
